title: Daily practice, scales and triple tonguing
summary: Father practiced daily scales and triple tongue, loved High Society; Harold recalls good clarinetists like Sidney Bean who go unmentioned.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing
